about: Sylvan Lake is a town in central Alberta on the south shore of Sylvan Lake, west of Red Deer. Summer beach crowds, a lakeside boardwalk, and year-round neighbourhoods make it one of the province’s best-known recreation lakes within an easy drive of the QEII Highway. About 16,000 people live in Sylvan Lake.
seoSummary: Central Alberta lakeside town west of Red Deer, known for its beach, boardwalk, and summer recreation.
